title: collab: document 'properties' merges whole-value LWW, contradicting the docs/37 per-field-merge spec
description: packages/collab/src/schema.ts:40-53 DOC_STRUCTURAL omits 'properties', so materializeDoc/diffDoc route it through materializeFields/diffFields (ymap-fields.ts:29-34) which does ymap.set('properties', cloneJson(wholeObject)) — one CRDT register, whole-value last-writer-wins. docs/37 §2 table and §5/§8 P0 acceptance state 'properties (and all its fields) | per-field Y.Map entries on the root | per-field merge of doc props'. Two peers concurrently editing different doc properties (A stage width, B frameRate; or snap toggle vs backgroundColor) -> one change silently discarded on convergence. The property/round-trip test can't catch it (single-doc sequential); binding.test.ts per-field-merge only covers a display object's x vs y. Fix: either (a) flatten properties.* into per-field root entries to match the spec, or (b) correct docs/37 to state properties are atomic LWW. Confidence: confirmed.
